comment: 17-4 PH precipitation-hardening stainless steel (SAE type 630), aged to about 44 HRC: Wikipedia '17-4 stainless steel' (density 7,800 to 7,900 kg/m3; 'approximately 44 Rc' after heat treatment). Hardness 409 HB: 44 HRC converted with the ASTM E140 tables. For condition A or H1150 stock the data here are on the safe side. kc1.1 2700 N/mm2: approximate, ISO 513 group M (precipitation hardened). mc 0.21: approximate, the typical value of row 13, stainless steel, martensitic, in the material group table 'according to DIN / ISO 513 and VDI 3323' (ISCAR catalogue page 'Material Groups'). Cutting data for this material are in the tools' presets.
name: 17-4 PH (H900)
